The '''MM(X)''' was a two-person operated [[grenade mortar]] that was developed by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn Munitions]]. The weapon was still in the experimental stages as of [[22 BBY/Legends|21.5 BBY]].
